upgrades.name: Draught-proofing
upgrades.text: Felt strips round the doors and fresh putty in every gap of the window frames. The builder's done by morning; the inn needn't shut.

upgrades.name: Lath and plaster
upgrades.text: The bare boards lined with lath and lime plaster, the cracks stopped with horsehair. The builders need the inn for a day.

upgrades.name: Storm windows
upgrades.text: A second sash outside every window, and a felted inner door. The warmth stays in, the heat of summer stays out, and the windows still open. The builders need the inn for a day.
